title: The Udupi Temple Circuit
hook: Dawn darshan, a free temple lunch, Car Street after dark.
route: Manipal → Udupi Sri Krishna Matha & the Ashta Mathas → Anantheshwara & Chandramouleeshwara Temples, Udupi → Udupi Sri Krishna Matha & the Ashta Mathas → Pajaka Kshetra (Madhvacharya's birthplace) → Kunjarugiri Durga Temple (Durga Betta) → Car Street (Ratha Beedi), Udupi after dark → Manipal

stops.name: Udupi Sri Krishna Matha & the Ashta Mathas
stops.note: Weekday dawn is the quietest darshan. Men go shirtless inside the Matha all day.

stops.name: Anantheshwara & Chandramouleeshwara Temples, Udupi
stops.note: Two Shiva temples across the square. Ten minutes each.

stops.name: Udupi Sri Krishna Matha & the Ashta Mathas
stops.note: Back for prasada bhojana at noon.

stops.name: Pajaka Kshetra (Madhvacharya's birthplace)
stops.note: Madhvacharya's birthplace, through the paddy.

stops.name: Kunjarugiri Durga Temple (Durga Betta)
stops.note: Short climb, wide views at golden hour.

stops.name: Car Street (Ratha Beedi), Udupi after dark
stops.note: Evening palanquin round and night pujas around the square.

vegMealStops: Mitra Samaj (Car Street): goli baje and buns for breakfast after darshan.
Krishna Matha prasada bhojana (free, noon).
Woodlands, Udupi: neer dosa with veg stew for dinner.
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: A dhoti or veshti for men, a shawl, a cloth bag for footwear, small change for the hundi.

title: Island Morning, Backwater Evening
hook: St Mary's basalt at 9, a kayak by 3, Delta's sandbar at sunset.
route: Manipal → St. Mary's Island (Thonsepar) → Malpe Beach & Sea Walk → Kemmannu Hanging Bridge & Hoode backwaters → Delta Beach (Kodi Bengre) → Manipal

stops.name: St. Mary's Island (Thonsepar)
stops.note: First boats from Malpe beat the heat and the crowds. No food on the island.

stops.name: Malpe Beach & Sea Walk
stops.note: Walk the Sea Walk out to the breakwater.

stops.name: Kemmannu Hanging Bridge & Hoode backwaters
stops.note: Hanging bridge, then kayak the Hoode backwater.

stops.name: Delta Beach (Kodi Bengre)
stops.note: Sunset where the Swarna meets the sea. Look, do not swim.

vegMealStops: Mitra Samaj or Woodlands in Udupi town for lunch (no pure-veg spot at the Malpe jetty could be confirmed).
Carry water and snacks for the island.
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Mar, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Sunscreen, a cap, a dry bag for the kayak, a change of clothes, 2 litres of water.

title: The NH-66 Sunset Run
hook: Two Ganapatis, three beaches and the best sunset on the coast.
route: Manipal → Anegudde Sri Vinayaka Temple (Kumbashi) → Hattiangadi Siddhi Vinayaka Temple → Kodi Beach & Sea Walk (Kundapura) → Trasi Beach → Maravanthe Beach → Ottinene Viewpoint (Kshitija Nesara Dhama), Byndoor → Manipal

stops.name: Anegudde Sri Vinayaka Temple (Kumbashi)
stops.note: Morning darshan at Kumbashi.

stops.name: Hattiangadi Siddhi Vinayaka Temple
stops.note: A short detour inland.

stops.name: Kodi Beach & Sea Walk (Kundapura)
stops.note: Sea walk across from Gangolli.

stops.name: Trasi Beach
stops.note: Back on NH-66 after a long lunch break out of the sun.

stops.name: Maravanthe Beach
stops.note: Sea on one side, Sauparnika river on the other.

stops.name: Ottinene Viewpoint (Kshitija Nesara Dhama), Byndoor
stops.note: Sunset from the hill, with Someshwara beach below.

vegMealStops: Anegudde temple anna prasada (lunch time).
Hotel Parijatha, Kundapura (pure veg; status: verify locally).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Mar, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Sunglasses, a scarf for the sea wind, a headlamp, and a reflective vest for the ride home.
safety: Riding back from Byndoor after sunset means about 75 km of NH-66 in the dark. Ride slow, or stay the night in Byndoor or Kundapura.

title: Agumbe, Sringeri & Horanadu
hook: A lake basadi, a rainforest ghat, two great temple kitchens.
route: Manipal → Varanga Kere Basadi (Lake Temple) → Sringeri Sharada Peetham → Agumbe Ghat & Sunset Point → Horanadu Annapoorneshwari Temple → Return via Kalasa–Kudremukh–Karkala → Manipal

stops.name: Varanga Kere Basadi (Lake Temple)
stops.note: First boat out to the lake temple.

stops.name: Sringeri Sharada Peetham
stops.note: Darshan, then the annadana lunch from 12:15 pm.

stops.name: Agumbe Ghat & Sunset Point
stops.note: Be at the sunset point early; stay the night in Agumbe.

stops.name: Horanadu Annapoorneshwari Temple
stops.note: Morning darshan, stay for the annadana lunch.

stops.name: Return via Kalasa–Kudremukh–Karkala
stops.note: Leave by early afternoon to be off the forest roads before dark.

vegMealStops: Sringeri Sharada Peetham annadana (lunch about 12:15–2:30 pm).
Hotel Sri Krishna Bhavan or a vegetarian homestay in Agumbe (verify locally).
Horanadu annadana (lunch).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: A dhoti or veshti (Horanadu asks men to remove shirts), a warm layer for the Agumbe evening, a rain shell, a headlamp.
safety: Agumbe and the Kudremukh road are hairpin ghats: daylight only, watch for buses on the bends and for fog.

title: Dharmasthala & the Belthangady Rocks
hook: 1,876 steps up Gadaikallu, then Annapoorna feeds you.
route: Manipal → Venur Bahubali → Gadaikallu (Jamalabad Fort) → Dharmasthala Shri Manjunatha Swamy Temple → Ratnagiri Bahubali, Manjusha Museum & Vintage Car Museum, Dharmasthala → Sowthadka Shri Mahaganapati Temple → Shishila Shishileshwara Temple (Matsya Theertha) → Manipal

stops.name: Venur Bahubali
stops.note: A 38 ft monolith on the Phalguni, on the way.

stops.name: Gadaikallu (Jamalabad Fort)
stops.note: Climb before the rock heats up. Open October–May only.

stops.name: Dharmasthala Shri Manjunatha Swamy Temple
stops.note: Evening darshan; stay the night in Dharmasthala.

stops.name: Ratnagiri Bahubali, Manjusha Museum & Vintage Car Museum, Dharmasthala
stops.note: Ratnagiri Bahubali in the morning, museums after.

stops.name: Sowthadka Shri Mahaganapati Temple
stops.note: The open-air Ganapati.

stops.name: Shishila Shishileshwara Temple (Matsya Theertha)
stops.note: The sacred fish in the Kapila river.

vegMealStops: Annapoorna dining hall, Dharmasthala (free annadana: dinner on day 1, lunch on day 2).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Mar, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Grip shoes for the rock, 2 litres of water per person, a dhoti for darshan, a towel.
safety: Gadaikallu has no rails on parts of the final rock face: no climbing in rain, and come down well before the 4 pm cutoff.

title: Kollur & the Sauparnika Falls
hook: Mookambika at dawn, a forest fall by noon, sunset over Byndoor.
route: Manipal → Kollur Mookambika Temple → Belkal Theertha (Govinda Theertha) Falls → Kollur Mookambika Temple → Ottinene Viewpoint (Kshitija Nesara Dhama), Byndoor → Manipal

stops.name: Kollur Mookambika Temple
stops.note: Morning darshan; stay for the anna prasada lunch.

stops.name: Belkal Theertha (Govinda Theertha) Falls
stops.note: Best October–January, while it still flows.

stops.name: Kollur Mookambika Temple
stops.note: Back for lunch prasada.

stops.name: Ottinene Viewpoint (Kshitija Nesara Dhama), Byndoor
stops.note: Sunset on the way home.

vegMealStops: Kollur temple anna prasada (lunch).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Dhoti or saree for darshan, grip sandals for the falls trail, leech socks after the rains, a headlamp.
safety: Arasinagundi Falls is closed by forest order: do not try it. Falls rocks are slippery in every season.

title: The Jain Heritage Loop
hook: Three Bahubalis, a thousand pillars and a temple on a lake.
route: Manipal → Karkala: Gommateshwara (Bahubali) & Chaturmukha Basadi → Varanga Kere Basadi (Lake Temple) → Saavira Kambada Basadi, Moodbidri → Venur Bahubali → Manipal

stops.name: Karkala: Gommateshwara (Bahubali) & Chaturmukha Basadi
stops.note: Barefoot climb to Gommata before the rock warms up.

stops.name: Varanga Kere Basadi (Lake Temple)
stops.note: Boat out to the lake basadi.

stops.name: Saavira Kambada Basadi, Moodbidri
stops.note: The Thousand-Pillar Basadi and the town walk.

stops.name: Venur Bahubali
stops.note: The riverside Bahubali in soft afternoon light.

vegMealStops: Lunch in Moodbidri town (pick a pure-veg hotel on the spot; none was confirmed online, so verify locally).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Socks for hot stone floors, modest clothes (shoulders and knees covered), water.

title: Kudremukh Summit
hook: Sixteen kilometres of shola and grass to the horse-face peak.
route: Manipal → Karkala: Gommateshwara (Bahubali) & Chaturmukha Basadi → Mullodi homestay → Kudremukh Peak Trek → Manipal

stops.name: Karkala: Gommateshwara (Bahubali) & Chaturmukha Basadi
stops.note: On the way up via Karkala.

stops.name: Mullodi homestay
stops.note: Sleep at the trailhead; arrange the jeep from Balagal if needed.

stops.name: Kudremukh Peak Trek
stops.note: Start at the Mullodi forest office; turn back by 2 pm.

vegMealStops: Mullodi homestay: dinner, breakfast and a packed lunch (confirm a veg-only meal when you book).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Aranya Vihaara booking + the original ID you booked with, 3 litres of water, trail shoes, a rain shell, snacks, no plastic (bags are checked).
safety: A guide is compulsory. Trails close in the monsoon, and in 2026 closed from 14 January for fire season, so plan for October–December.

title: Kukke & Kumara Parvatha
hook: Karnataka's toughest day hike, after darshan at Kukke.
route: Manipal → Kukke Shri Subrahmanya Temple → Kumara Parvatha Trek (Kukke Subramanya route) → Kukke Shri Subrahmanya Temple → Manipal

stops.name: Kukke Shri Subrahmanya Temple
stops.note: Ride over, evening darshan, sleep in Kukke.

stops.name: Kumara Parvatha Trek (Kukke Subramanya route)
stops.note: Single-day trek, 11–12 hours from the Kukke side: no camping, no overnight at Bhattara Mane. Check which route is open first.

stops.name: Kukke Shri Subrahmanya Temple
stops.note: Rest, a slow morning darshan, then ride home in daylight.

vegMealStops: Kukke temple annadana (lunch about 11:30 am–2 pm, dinner about 7:30–9:30 pm; verify locally).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Aranya Vihaara booking + original ID, 3–4 litres of water, electrolytes, a headlamp, trekking poles, knee support.
safety: In 2026 only the Beedahalli (Kodagu side) route had reopened; if the Kukke route is still shut, the Beedahalli checkpost is about 208 km from Manipal. Never start late, and never ride back the same evening.

title: Gokarna & Murudeshwar by Train
hook: Konkan Railway to the cliff-beach trail, Shiva by the sea.
route: Manipal → Udupi station → Gokarna Road (Konkan Railway) → Gokarna Mahabaleshwar Temple → Gokarna beach trail: Kudle, Om, Half Moon & Paradise → Gokarna Road → Murdeshwar (Konkan Railway) → Murudeshwar Temple & Beach → Murdeshwar → Udupi (Konkan Railway)

stops.name: Udupi station → Gokarna Road (Konkan Railway)
stops.note: Check trains on NTES/IRCTC; Gokarna Road is about 9 km from town by auto.

stops.name: Gokarna Mahabaleshwar Temple
stops.note: Men in dhoti, no shirt; women in saree or salwar.

stops.name: Gokarna beach trail: Kudle, Om, Half Moon & Paradise
stops.note: Kudle to Om on foot; stay the night in Gokarna.

stops.name: Gokarna Road → Murdeshwar (Konkan Railway)
stops.note: Check which trains stop at Murdeshwar.

stops.name: Murudeshwar Temple & Beach
stops.note: Temple, the gopura lift, the beach within the ropes.

vegMealStops: Mahabaleshwar temple prasada bhojana (free).
Pai Restaurant, Gokarna (pure veg; verify locally).
Murudeshwar temple annadana.
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Mar, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: A printed or saved ticket, dhoti for Gokarna, trail sandals, 2 litres of water for the cliff path, a torch.
safety: Do not swim at Paradise or Half Moon (rocks, undercurrents), and be off the cliff paths before dark.

title: Dudhsagar: The Night-Train Special
hook: Sleep on the Netravati, wake in Goa, ride a jeep to the 'sea of milk'.
duration: 2 days (one night on the train each way)
route: Manipal → Udupi → Madgaon (16346 Netravati Exp, dep about 00:22) → Madgaon → Kulem (56962 passenger, about 08:10) → Dudhsagar Falls (overnight via Konkan Railway + Collem jeep safari) → Kulem → Madgaon (56965, about 17:20), then 16345 Netravati home (about 22:42)

stops.name: Udupi → Madgaon (16346 Netravati Exp, dep about 00:22)
stops.note: Timings from etrain.info; confirm on NTES/IRCTC.

stops.name: Madgaon → Kulem (56962 passenger, about 08:10)
stops.note: Breakfast near Madgaon station first.

stops.name: Dudhsagar Falls (overnight via Konkan Railway + Collem jeep safari)
stops.note: Official forest-dept jeep safari from Collem (gate 8 am–3 pm, life jackets mandatory).

stops.name: Kulem → Madgaon (56965, about 17:20), then 16345 Netravati home (about 22:42)
stops.note: Arrive Udupi around 3 am.

vegMealStops: Krishna or Pai Palace near Madgaon station (pure veg per listings; verify locally).
Carry lunch for the jeep day.
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Train tickets + ID, cash for the jeep, a dry bag, quick-dry clothes, a light blanket for the AC coach.
safety: Walking on the railway tracks to Dudhsagar is prohibited: RPF has fined tourists. Use only the official jeep safari. By bike, break the ride overnight at Gokarna or Karwar.

title: Mangaluru by Train
hook: Temples, a ferry across the river, and the original gadbad.
route: Manipal → Udupi → Mangaluru Central/Junction (Konkan Railway) → Kadri Manjunatha Temple → Mangaladevi Temple (Bolar) → Kudroli Shree Gokarnanatha Kshetra → Sultan Battery (Boloor) → Tannirbhavi Beach & Sultan Battery ferry

stops.name: Udupi → Mangaluru Central/Junction (Konkan Railway)
stops.note: Check which station your train uses; the two are about 6 km apart.

stops.name: Kadri Manjunatha Temple
stops.note: Before the midday break.

stops.name: Mangaladevi Temple (Bolar)
stops.note: The goddess the city is named after.

stops.name: Kudroli Shree Gokarnanatha Kshetra
stops.note: Colourful gopuram, evening puja.

stops.name: Sultan Battery (Boloor)
stops.note: Tipu's watchtower, then the ferry across.

stops.name: Tannirbhavi Beach & Sultan Battery ferry
stops.note: Sunset; ask at the jetty for the last ferry back.

vegMealStops: New Taj Mahal Café (Kodialbail): buns and tuppa dosa.
Woodlands or Indra Bhavan for a banana-leaf meal.
Pabbas: gadbad (an ice-cream parlour; pure-veg status not stated, so order the ice cream).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Train ticket, small cash for autos and the ferry, a hat, comfortable sandals.

title: Ananthapura & Bekal
hook: A lake temple with a crocodile story, then Kerala's biggest fort.
route: Manipal → Ananthapura Lake Temple → Madhur Madanantheshwara Siddhivinayaka Temple → Chandragiri Fort (Kasaragod) → Bekal Fort → Manipal

stops.name: Ananthapura Lake Temple
stops.note: Morning light on the tank; open till 12:30 pm.

stops.name: Madhur Madanantheshwara Siddhivinayaka Temple
stops.note: Three-tiered roof on the Madhuvahini river.

stops.name: Chandragiri Fort (Kasaragod)
stops.note: River-mouth views.

stops.name: Bekal Fort
stops.note: Open till 5:30 pm; afternoon light on the ramparts.

vegMealStops: Udupi Sree Krishna Veg Restaurant or Vrindavan Pure Veg near Bekal (verify locally).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Mar, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: ID for the Kerala border, cash for the ₹25 fort ticket, a hat, water.
safety: Bekal is about 125 km each way on NH-66: leave Bekal by 5:30 pm and expect to finish the ride in the dark, or take the train back from Kasaragod.

hook: A Keladi fort, Kuvempu's home and the view from Kundadri.
route: Manipal → Kavaledurga Fort → Kuppalli: Kuvempu's Kavimane & Kavishaila → Kundadri Hill & Jain Temple → Agumbe Ghat & Sunset Point → Manipal

stops.name: Kavaledurga Fort
stops.note: Climb in the cool morning.

stops.name: Kuppalli: Kuvempu's Kavimane & Kavishaila
stops.note: Kuvempu's house, then the walk up to Kavishaila.

stops.name: Kundadri Hill & Jain Temple
stops.note: Jain temple on top; be down before dark.

stops.name: Agumbe Ghat & Sunset Point
stops.note: Sunset, then descend the ghat slowly.

vegMealStops: Thirthahalli town for lunch (pick a pure-veg hotel on the spot; verify locally).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.

title: Charmadi to the Hoysalas
hook: A dawn ghat climb to the most ornate temples in Karnataka.
route: Manipal → Dharmasthala Shri Manjunatha Swamy Temple → Charmadi Ghat Ride (Ujire to Kottigehara) → Belur Chennakeshava & Halebidu Hoysaleswara Temples → Manipal

stops.name: Dharmasthala Shri Manjunatha Swamy Temple
stops.note: Ride out at 4:30 for first darshan (or stay in Dharmasthala the night before).

stops.name: Charmadi Ghat Ride (Ujire to Kottigehara)
stops.note: Daylight only; wait out any morning mist at the top.

stops.name: Belur Chennakeshava & Halebidu Hoysaleswara Temples
stops.note: Belur Chennakeshava in the afternoon; stay in Belur or Hassan.

stops.name: Belur Chennakeshava & Halebidu Hoysaleswara Temples
stops.note: Halebidu Hoysaleswara in the morning, then ride home before dark.

vegMealStops: Annapoorna, Dharmasthala (breakfast/lunch annadana).
Belur town for dinner (pick a pure-veg hotel; verify locally).
bestSeason: Best when every stop is in season: Jan, Feb, Mar, Apr, May, Oct, Nov, Dec. See each place's season note.
packThis: Riding jacket and gloves, a rain shell, modest clothes for the temples, a power bank.
safety: Charmadi has tight hairpins, heavy trucks and landslide history: never ride it at night or in heavy rain.
